issue: DirectoryStream enumerated remaining runs without checking their recorded identities/count, so a disappeared completed run could be skipped.
evidence: Primary read of pre-fix aggregate loop; author confirmed and changed to deterministic run-i enumeration.
repair: Use recorded count and bounded fan-in path groups; missing required run fails opening.
postFix: RootExternalProbe: 901 rows / 29 keys / 9 chunk-fan-in pairs plus disappeared-run injection all passed.

issue: attempt_end was set before scheduling at now+220ms; worker required remaining>=220ms, rejecting every positive scheduling delay.
evidence: Primary read of initial retry.pseudo and author confirmation.
repair: Declare a 100ms minimum useful budget within the absolute 220ms cap, including positive scheduling time; all acquired worker resources now have outer cleanup, including quota adapters.

issue: Author main expected IllegalArgumentException for Math.incrementExact overflow, which actually throws ArithmeticException.
evidence: Primary read of DomainModel.java final test.
repair: Correct test expectation; retain actual overflow failure boundary.

issue: A single completed run could disappear before final return; zero merge waves skipped all required-input opening.
repair: Open/read final candidate at handoff; retaining it afterward remains owner/publication responsibility.

issue: Quota adapter threw outside cleanup, leaking a local I/O slot and unfinished breaker ticket.
repair: All worker-owned paths share outer try/catch/finally; quota uses a bounded deadline and non-granted outcomes do not dispatch.

issue: SQLite promoted exhausted version arithmetic to REAL and committed a version beyond Java long.
repair: Explicit exact integer/signed64 increment check and schema type constraint; edit and capture abort atomically.

issue: CAS=0 was quarantined as invalid data rather than retaining a retry/no-ACK path.
repair: RetryableConflict rolls back all participating data and leaves same-message reentry possible.
